meta.title: SolidStart Data Loading Reference
meta.purpose: LLM assistant reference for SolidStart data fetching patterns

overview.description: SolidStart aims to make it easy to load data from your data sources to keep your UI updated with your data. For most of your data requirements, routes will likely be used to decide what data to load. SolidStart includes nested routing to help structure your application's UI in a hierarchical way, so that you can share layouts.

core-primitive.name: createResource
core-primitive.description: Solid provides a way to load data from your data sources using the createResource primitive. It takes an async function and returns a signal from it. createResource integrates with Suspense and ErrorBoundary to help manage lifecycle and error states.

pattern.title: Basic Data Loading with createResource

caveats.caveat: Can encounter unnecessary waterfalls when nested under lazy loaded sections
Recommended to hoist data fetching to top of component tree

pattern.title: Router-Based Data Caching
pattern.description: Using solid-router features to create cached data loading

pattern.title: Server-Only Data Loading
pattern.description: Using "use server" directive for server-side only data access

benefits.benefit: Code only runs on server, not included in client bundle
Direct database access without API routes

caveat.description: The preload function is called once per route, which is the first time the user comes to that route. Following that, the fine-grained resources that remain alive synchronize with state/url changes to refetch data when needed.
caveat.solution: Use the refetch function returned in createResource if data needs refresh

caveat.description: Before the route is rendered, the preload function is called. It does not share the same context as the route. The context tree that is exposed to the preload function is anything above the Page component.
On both the server and the client, the preload function is called. The resources can avoid refetching if they serialized their data in the server render.
caveat.note: The server-side render will only wait for the resources to fetch and serialize if the resource signals are accessed under a Suspense boundary.

server-functions.title: Server-Only Functions
server-functions.description: An advantage of being a full-stack JavaScript framework is that it is easy to write data loading code that can run both on the server and client. SolidStart offers a way to do that and more. Through the "use server" comment you can tell the bundler to create an RPC and not include the code in the clients bundle.

use-cases.use-case: Sensitive operations that shouldn't be exposed to client

directive.effect: Creates RPC endpoint, excludes code from client bundle
